messages.subject: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo Herr Dralveck,

Thank you for your improved quote. We see room to move closer:

A current rival offer stands at EUR 31.00 per unit (offer:70250-1).
The stainless bar index AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.

The attached packages cover 4200 pc per year over 24 months. You can choose between payment terms of 14, 30 or 60 days. Could your office manager reflect the lower material and energy costs in the costing? Is a cheaper material or process variant possible within drawing rev. B?

Gruß
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I checked your numbers on the material and energy indexes, and you are spot on, so I am passing those savings on to you. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Our offer is a price of €28.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. These are our standard terms. 

As an alternative option, fast payment helps us keep the machines running, so if we go with the 14 days payment, I can do 28.00 EUR per piece. That alternative package is a price of €28.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
